 COLLIERVILLE, Tenn. — The Town of Collierville paid tribute to military veterans Sunday, Nov. 8, during a special Veterans Day celebration recognizing the men and women who have served in the United States armed forces.
 The celebration was held at the Harrell Performing Arts Theatre, where the town honored veterans for their military service and sacrifices.
 In a Facebook post Sunday, town officials expressed appreciation for those who have served the country and helped protect the freedoms Americans enjoy.
 "We are grateful for the courage, sacrifice, and dedication of our veterans, whose service has helped protect the freedoms we enjoy every day," the town wrote.
 The celebration came ahead of Veterans Day, which is observed annually on Nov. 11.
 The federal holiday recognizes Americans who have served in the military, honoring their contributions during times of war and peace.
 Collierville officials emphasized the importance of recognizing veterans not only during the annual holiday but throughout the year.
 The town concluded its message by expressing continued gratitude to veterans and their families.
